<<<SOLUTION_CODE>>>
const values = require('node:fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);

let index = 0;
const n = values[index++] ?? 0;
const intervals = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
  const l = values[index++] ?? 0;
  const r = values[index++] ?? 0;
  intervals.push([l, r]);
}

intervals.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]);

let answer = 0;
let curL = 0;
let curR = -1;

for (const [l, r] of intervals) {
  if (curR < l - 1) {
    if (curR >= curL) answer += curR - curL + 1;
    curL = l;
    curR = r;
  } else if (r > curR) {
    curR = r;
  }
}

if (curR >= curL) answer += curR - curL + 1;

process.stdout.write(String(answer));
<<<MAKER_TS>>>
import { defineDataset, fmt } from 'genesis-kit';

type Input = {
  n: number;
  intervals: number[][];
};

export default defineDataset<Input>({
  solution: 'std.js',
  seed: 'interval-union-dataset-v1',
  format: ({ n, intervals }) => fmt.lines(
    [n],
    fmt.table(intervals),
  ),
  validate: ({ n, intervals }) => {
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1 || n > 100000) return 'n out of range';
    if (!Array.isArray(intervals) || intervals.length !== n) return 'interval count must equal n';
    for (const interval of intervals) {
      if (!Array.isArray(interval) || interval.length !== 2) return 'each interval must contain two numbers';
      const [l, r] = interval;
      if (!Number.isInteger(l) || !Number.isInteger(r)) return 'interval endpoints must be integers';
      if (l < 1 || r < 1 || l > 1000000000 || r > 1000000000) return 'interval endpoint out of range';
      if (l > r) return 'interval must satisfy l <= r';
    }
    return true;
  },
  cases: [
    {
      name: 'single-point',
      tags: ['edge'],
      input: {
        n: 1,
        intervals: [[7, 7]],
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'sample',
      tags: ['sample'],
      input: {
        n: 4,
        intervals: [
          [1, 3],
          [2, 5],
          [8, 8],
          [10, 12],
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'disjoint-sorted',
      input: {
        n: 5,
        intervals: [
          [1, 2],
          [5, 5],
          [8, 10],
          [20, 25],
          [30, 30],
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'nested-and-overlapping',
      input: {
        n: 6,
        intervals: [
          [1, 10],
          [2, 3],
          [4, 7],
          [6, 12],
          [11, 15],
          [14, 20],
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'generated-overlap-heavy',
      tags: ['random'],
      repeat: 2,
      generate: ({ g }) => {
        const n = g.int(20, 60);
        const intervals = g.intervals(n, 1, 1000, {
          overlapping: true,
          sorted: false,
          minLen: 1,
          maxLen: 80,
        });
        return { n, intervals };
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'generated-disjoint-large',
      tags: ['random'],
      generate: ({ g }) => {
        const n = 100000;
        const intervals = g.intervals(n, 1, 1000000000, {
          overlapping: false,
          sorted: false,
          minLen: 1,
          maxLen: 20,
          allowGaps: true,
        });
        return { n, intervals };
      },
    },
  ],
});
